rawContent: until the bad cops are prosecuted for their crimes, until the good cops hold the bad cops accountable, ALL cops are bad. The riots will not stop. The protests will not stop. The videos will not stop. The demand for justice will NOT stop. #BlackLivesMatter #ThisIsAmerica
